instruction.text: The pupils in Year 5 go to different after-school clubs. Use the table to complete the sentences.

atoms.b: In class 5C, ((fewer ++more)) children go to netball club than any other club.
Exactly three children from class 5B go to ((netball ++gardening Spanish computer chess)) club.
In class 5A, ((++fewer more)) children go to gardening club than any other club. However, there are ((++10 15 5 6)) children from this class who are signed up for chess club.
There are a total of ((15 ++14 10 4)) pupils who go to computer club. With only ((++8 10 5 7)) members, gardening club was the ((most ++least)) popular club.
((++5 4 10 8)) pupils in class 5B go to computer club.
There are the same number of pupils from both class 5A and class 5B in ((netball gardening Spanish ++computer chess)) club.
In class 5C, there are the same number of pupils in ((netball ++gardening ++Spanish computer chess)) club and ((netball ++gardening ++Spanish computer chess)) club.
